subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Skateboard Platform
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Skateboard Platform.

hook.text: Most modern EVs mount their battery pack flat across the entire floor, creating a skateboard shape.

buildup.text: This layout drops the center of gravity low, giving EVs cornering stability that SUVs never had.

discovery.text: The flat floor also frees up cabin space—no transmission tunnel means more room for passengers.

twist.text: Some manufacturers now make the battery pack a structural part of the car's body, saving weight.

climax.text: Tesla's structural battery pack acts as both energy storage and the car's floor, eliminating parts.

punchline.text: The battery isn't just in the car—it is the car's foundation.

quiz.question: What advantage does the skateboard battery layout provide?
options: Low center of gravity and more cabin space
